design.purpose: A warm two-tone neck cowl for one adult, worked in the round with the photographed green and blue chunky wool and 15 mm hook.

steps.c: Green: chain 32, slip stitch to join ring.
Round 3: 32 double crochet, change to blue.
Round 6: 32 double crochet, slip stitch, fasten off.
Cut blue yarn, leaving a 15 cm tail.
Weave both tails through nearby stitches, then trim.
